title: deBakker2026-appa: Bayesian analysis of appa genotype effect on pE11 and 4G8 immunoreactivity
description: Data, Stan model and R script reproducing the Bayesian estimates of the appa genotype effect on pE11 and 4G8 immunoreactivity in the anterior rhombencephalon and hypothalamus superior lobe of 6-month-old turquoise killifish (de Bakker et al., Nature Aging, 2026).
